source_refs.note: Amorphous or Glassy Solids: a main subheading of 5.1 Classification of solids, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 93-93.

blocks.text: Amorphous ka matlab hai “baghair shakal ya structure ke”. Amorphous solids mein molecules ki crystalline solids jaisi regular tarteeb nahi hoti. Is liye keh sakte hain ke amorphous solids un liquids jaise hain jin ki be-tarteeb structure jam (freeze ho) gayi ho.

Misal: aam sheesha (glass) aam temperature par solid hai lekin us ke molecules ki koi regular tarteeb nahi. Garam karne par yeh aahista aahista naram ho kar paste jaisa banta hai, aur taqreeban 800°C par bohat gaarha (viscous) liquid ban jata hai. Isi liye amorphous solids ko glassy solids bhi kehte hain. In ka koi fixed melting point nahi hota, maslan plastic, glass aur fused silica.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf, Crystalline solids: ek jaisi neeli-hari gendein seedhi rows aur columns mein, khali jagahon mein doosri layer nazar aati hai. Daen taraf, Amorphous solids: wahi gendein baghair kisi regular tarteeb ke bikhri hui, beech na-barabar faasle.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne glassy solid ki misal “fused silicon” likhi hai. Sahi lafz fused silica (fused quartz, SiO₂) hai; silicon khud ek crystalline element hai, glassy solid nahi.
